purpose: Local prerequisite and bounded diagnostic experiment; no superiority claim

development_selection.rule: Maximize completions, then minimize observed fall/drop, violations and censoring. Ties prefer the earlier shared_actions entry. No held-out data used.

delay_sweep.rule: Report every tested action/delay, including failures; no universal or optimal-controller bound. Nonmonotonic cells yield ranges, not a fitted deadline.

heldout.arm_order: Common-policy prefix first; rotate the other three arms by configuration/family index to distribute host timing effects.
heldout.split: Entire unseen configuration tuples and sensor seeds. No adjacent-frame split. Mechanism families remain known; this is configuration transfer, not unseen-mechanism generalization.

stress.role: Sensitivity checks, separate from held-out effect estimates. No retuning after these runs.

analysis.paired_completion_interval: Conservative 95% paired risk-difference interval: exact binomial intervals for paired wins and losses, Bonferroni combined; no independence between frames assumed.
analysis.constraint_censoring: Report observed violations and censoring separately; a terminated trajectory does not establish absence of later fall or constraint violation.
analysis.prefix_overlap: Compare common-policy slip/load observations at matched timestamps, with RMS differences scaled by electronic noise and separately by declared modeling allowances. Three consecutive frames above 3 allowance units mark separation for this diagnostic only, not calibrated inference.
analysis.effective_action: Use applied_command after explicit 20ms delivery delay, not issued command or classifier output; 0.1 Nm difference threshold and next physics step.
analysis.advance: Require positive lower 95% completion-effect bound or positive lower bound on reduction in observed violations with no censoring; no lost nominal completions, no added nominal falls/violations/interventions, and completed nominal time penalty at most max(0.25 seconds, 5%). Otherwise do not advance. Require exact matched pre-decision histories for all compared arms.

timing: Fixed 20ms computation/delivery schedule advances physics on previous admitted command; host wall overruns recorded separately, never unpaired physical treatments. No hardware real-time qualification.
supersedes: frozen-campaign-01: stopped for wall-scheduler confounding; its outcomes do not select the new baseline or establish paired effects.
